countries.reasoning: South Africa is the dominant producer of iridium due to large PGM (platinum-group metals) mines. Data is from USGS 2023, highly reliable and recent.
Russia produces significant iridium mainly from Norilsk Nickel operations. Data from USGS 2023; generally reliable but with some reporting gaps.
Zimbabwe is a noted producer of PGMs including iridium. Data is less comprehensive but supported by regional mining reports from 2021-2023.
Canada has smaller-scale iridium production primarily from PGM mines in Ontario and Quebec. Data is moderate in reliability from industry sources 2022.
The US produces some iridium as a byproduct of PGM mining in Montana. Data is approximate, with limited detailed reporting but consistent presence.
